subtitle.en: A Funeral for a City — Five Acrostic Dirges Over Fallen Jerusalem
subtitle.hans: 一座城的葬礼——为陷落耶路撒冷所作的五首字母离合诗
subtitle.hant: 一座城的葬禮——為陷落耶路撒冷所作的五首字母離合詩

summary.en: Five poems mourning the destruction of Jerusalem in 586 BCE. Yet at the very center of the book — chapter 3 verses 22-23 — stands one of the Bible's most beloved declarations of God's mercy: 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases.'
summary.hans: 五首哀歌，悲叹公元前586年耶路撒冷被毁。然而全书的核心——第三章22–23节——却是圣经中关于神怜悯最为人熟知的宣告：「雅伟的慈爱永不断绝。」
summary.hant: 五首哀歌，悲嘆公元前586年耶路撒冷被毀。然而全書的核心——第三章22–23節——卻是聖經中關於神憐憫最為人熟知的宣告：「雅偉的慈愛永不斷絕。」

audience.en: Survivors of Jerusalem's fall and exiles in Babylon
audience.hans: 耶路撒冷陷落的幸存者及巴比伦被掳之民
audience.hant: 耶路撒冷陷落的倖存者及巴比倫被擄之民

keyPassageDesc.en: At the center of the city's grief: 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning.' The hymn 'Great Is Thy Faithfulness' takes its words from here.
keyPassageDesc.hans: 在国家悲哀的中心：「雅伟的慈爱永不断绝，祂的怜悯永不止息；每早晨这都是新的。」名诗歌《祢信实何广大》正取意于此。
keyPassageDesc.hant: 在國家悲哀的中心：「雅偉的慈愛永不斷絕，祂的憐憫永不止息；每早晨這都是新的。」名詩歌《祢信實何廣大》正取意於此。

25001001.contextHans: 锡安的悲叹——「先前满有人民的城，现在何竟独坐」。一座巨大的城被毁。
25001001.contextHant: 錫安的悲嘆——「先前滿有人民的城，現在何竟獨坐」。一座巨大的城被毀。
25001001.contextEn: How lonely sits the city — 'Once full of people, now deserted'. A great city laid waste.

25002001.contextHans: 主的忿怒——神是审判的主，也是亲手击打的那一位。难以面对的真理。
25002001.contextHant: 主的忿怒——神是審判的主，也是親手擊打的那一位。難以面對的真理。
25002001.contextEn: The LORD's anger — God is the judge, and the hand that struck. A hard truth to face.

25003001.contextHans: 「我所遭遇的痛苦」——先知耶利米以个人之声讲国家之苦。
25003001.contextHant: 「我所遭遇的痛苦」——先知耶利米以個人之聲講國家之苦。
25003001.contextEn: 'I am the man who has seen affliction' — Jeremiah's personal voice for national grief.

25003022.contextHans: 在国家最大的悲剧中央，先知发出最伟大的恩典宣告：「他的怜悯不止息」。
25003022.contextHant: 在國家最大的悲劇中央，先知發出最偉大的恩典宣告：「他的憐憫不止息」。
25003022.contextEn: At the heart of the city's grief stands one of Scripture's greatest declarations of grace: 'His mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning.'

25004001.contextHans: 围城的痛苦——母亲煮儿吃；金子失了光泽。最黑暗的画面。
25004001.contextHant: 圍城的痛苦——母親煮兒吃；金子失了光澤。最黑暗的畫面。
25004001.contextEn: Horrors of the siege — mothers cooking their children; gold tarnished. The darkest pages.

25005001.contextHans: 求神记念——本书结尾仍未定决。「难道你完全弃绝我们吗？」
25005001.contextHant: 求神記念——本書結尾仍未定決。「難道你完全棄絕我們嗎？」
25005001.contextEn: 'Restore us, O LORD' — the book ends without resolution. The unanswered question of every grief.

events.sumEn: Zion laments that the once-crowded city now sits alone, destroyed.

events.sumEn: The prophet celebrates God’s unfailing, renewed mercy, then calls from a deep dungeon for justice against his enemies.

events.sum: 求雅伟记念所受凌辱——产业归外邦人，出钱才得水喝，锡安山荒凉；「求你使我们向你回转」。
events.sumEn: The people ask Yahweh to remember their disgrace: foreigners own their land and water costs money. Zion is desolate, and they plead to be restored to God.
